newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Thailand sells unleaded gasoline at minus 75 cents.
newsitem.headline: Thailand sells unleaded gasoline at minus 75 cents.

text.p: Thailand's Star Petroleum Refining Co (SPRC) has awarded its tender to sell 220,000 barrel of June 92-octane unleaded gasoline at a discount of 75 cents per barrel to Singapore published quotes on a free-on-board Thailand basis, industry sources said on Tuesday.
The cargo has been awarded to BP Singapore and the cargo would be loading June 2-6 from Rayong, traders said.
The tender closed May 9 and was valid for two days.
The 130,000 barrels-per-day SPRC refinery is a 60:40 joint venture between Caltex and the Petroleum Authority of Thailand.
